name: Moroccan Almond Milk
description: Smooth chilled almond milk sweetened with sugar and perfumed with orange blossom water and rose water.
ingredients: a handful of finely chopped red onion
a handful of fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Combine the crusty bread and vegetable stock in a saucepan, blender, or pitcher, stirring well.
Add the ras el hanout and green olives, stirring gently so their flavor infuses the mixture.
Heat gently over low heat (or blend, or steep, depending on the drink) until well combined and fragrant, about 0 mins.
Strain through a fine sieve to remove any solids, if needed.
Sweeten to taste with dried apricots, adjusting gradually until the balance feels right.
Chill in the refrigerator, or pour straight over ice, depending on whether it is served cold or hot.
Garnish with parsley just before serving.
tips: Serve in a chilled glass for the most refreshing result on a hot day.
Adjust the sweetness gradually, tasting as you go — you can always add more dried apricots, but you cannot take it away.
If serving warm, gently reheat just before pouring rather than letting it come to a boil.
